    <style type="text/css">
      body:not(.loaded) {
        overflow: hidden scroll;
      }

      #site-loader {
        position: fixed;
        background: #1a69f3;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        left: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        z-index: 999999;
        transition: opacity 0.2s;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-element {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 140px;
        height: 140px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .white-stroke {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        background: white;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit--overflow {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: rotation 2s linear infinite;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit:after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: 110px;
        height: 110px;
        top: -55px;
        left: 11px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: black;
        z-index: 5;
      }

      #site-loader svg {
        z-index: 3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--mask {
        fill: #1a69f3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--logo {
        fill: white;
      }

      @keyframes rotation {
        0% {
          transform: rotate(0);
        }

        100% {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }

      body.loaded #site-loader {
        opacity: 0;
      }
    </style>

    <style type="text/css">
      body:not(.loaded) {
        overflow: hidden scroll;
      }

      #site-loader {
        position: fixed;
        background: #1a69f3;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        left: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        z-index: 999999;
        transition: opacity 0.2s;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-element {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 140px;
        height: 140px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .white-stroke {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        background: white;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit--overflow {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: rotation 2s linear infinite;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit:after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: 110px;
        height: 110px;
        top: -55px;
        left: 11px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: black;
        z-index: 5;
      }

      #site-loader svg {
        z-index: 3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--mask {
        fill: #1a69f3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--logo {
        fill: white;
      }

      @keyframes rotation {
        0% {
          transform: rotate(0);
        }

        100% {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }

      body.loaded #site-loader {
        opacity: 0;
      }
    </style>

    <style type="text/css">
      body:not(.loaded) {
        overflow: hidden scroll;
      }

      #site-loader {
        position: fixed;
        background: #1a69f3;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        left: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        z-index: 999999;
        transition: opacity 0.2s;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-element {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 140px;
        height: 140px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .white-stroke {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        background: white;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit--overflow {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: rotation 2s linear infinite;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit:after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: 110px;
        height: 110px;
        top: -55px;
        left: 11px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: black;
        z-index: 5;
      }

      #site-loader svg {
        z-index: 3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--mask {
        fill: #1a69f3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--logo {
        fill: white;
      }

      @keyframes rotation {
        0% {
          transform: rotate(0);
        }

        100% {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }

      body.loaded #site-loader {
        opacity: 0;
      }
    </style>

      #site-loader {

        background: #1a69f3;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;

        left: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        z-index: 999999;
        transition: opacity 0.2s;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-element {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 140px;
        height: 140px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .white-stroke {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        background: white;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit--overflow {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: rotation 2s linear infinite;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit:after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: 110px;
        height: 110px;
        top: -55px;
        left: 11px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: black;
        z-index: 5;
      }

      #site-loader svg {
        z-index: 3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--mask {
        fill: #1a69f3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--logo {
        fill: white;
      }

      @keyframes rotation {
        0% {
          transform: rotate(0);
        }

        100% {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }

      body.loaded #site-loader {
        opacity: 0;
      }

    <style type="text/css">
      body:not(.loaded) {
        overflow: hidden scroll;
      }

      #site-loader {
        position: fixed;
        background: #1a69f3;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        left: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        z-index: 999999;
        transition: opacity 0.2s;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-element {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 140px;
        height: 140px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .white-stroke {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        background: white;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit--overflow {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: rotation 2s linear infinite;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit:after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: 110px;
        height: 110px;
        top: -55px;
        left: 11px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: black;
        z-index: 5;
      }

      #site-loader svg {
        z-index: 3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--mask {
        fill: #1a69f3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--logo {
        fill: white;
      }

      @keyframes rotation {
        0% {
          transform: rotate(0);
        }

        100% {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }

      body.loaded #site-loader {
        opacity: 0;
      }
    </style>

    <style type="text/css">
      body:not(.loaded) {
        overflow: hidden scroll;
      }

      #site-loader {
        position: fixed;
        background: #1a69f3;
        top: 0;
        bottom: 0;
        right: 0;
        left: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        z-index: 999999;
        transition: opacity 0.2s;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-element {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 140px;
        height: 140px;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .white-stroke {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        background: white;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit--overflow {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit {
        display: block;
        width: 130px;
        height: 130px;
        position: absolute;
        border-radius: 50%;
        animation: rotation 2s linear infinite;
      }

      #site-loader .rotatable-unit:after {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        width: 110px;
        height: 110px;
        top: -55px;
        left: 11px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: black;
        z-index: 5;
      }

      #site-loader svg {
        z-index: 3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--mask {
        fill: #1a69f3;
      }

      #site-loader .loader-svg--logo {
        fill: white;
      }

      @keyframes rotation {
        0% {
          transform: rotate(0);
        }

        100% {
          transform: rotate(360deg);
        }
      }

      body.loaded #site-loader {
        opacity: 0;
      }
    </style>
